name: Vialactea Works
approach: Minimalist Milky Way symbol: two sweeping arms and a central nucleus.
inspirationNotes: Reference studied for monochrome silhouette and sweeping curves. No reference artwork is distributed or reused.

generation.primaryPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: primary symbol for the GitHub organization Vialactea Works.
Primary request: Create one exceptionally refined minimalist logo representing the Milky Way galaxy, suitable for a serious advanced-software organization. Symbol only, no text.
Subject: A compact tilted spiral galaxy seen slightly from above, built from two bold interlocking tapered spiral arms sweeping around a small luminous solid central nucleus. The result should have a strong, simple circular-to-oval silhouette, visible negative-space separation, a sense of deliberate orbital movement, and an approximately 25-degree upward diagonal. Aim for a singular recognizable mark made of very few shapes. Galaxy spiral, not Saturn or a ringed planet. Do not use an enclosing circle.
Style: precise flat vector-style graphic, elegantly geometric and optically balanced, assertive and spare. Smooth continuous curves, bold enough for 32px.
Color: a single uniform warm off-white #F4F1EB mark on a perfectly flat uniform near-black #101116 background.
Composition: square canvas, centered symbol occupying roughly 65% of width and 58% of height with ample quiet space around all sides, no border or rounded container.
Constraints: one mark only; no text, lettering, wordmark, mockup, gradients, glow, shadows, fine lines, decorative stars, sparkles, particles, realism, texture, 3D, watermarks, or complex nested rings. The arms must not resemble a hurricane weather pictogram or three-bladed fan. Use two main sweeping forms and a small core, with confident broad negative spaces.

No gradient, illumination, texture, shading, or color variation. No added text or details. Preserve the source composition and shape accurately. This is a transparent professional logo asset.
